records.quote: The influence of R2O3 substitution on the electrical properties and the thermoelectric power on the W-type hexaferrite Ba0.95R0.05 Mg-0.5 Zn-0.5 CO Fe-16 O-27; R=Y3+, Er3+, Ho3+, Sm3+, Nd3+, Gd3+, and Ce3+ ions as a function of the absolute temperature and frequency in the ranges 300-750 K and 100 kHz-4 MHz, respectively have been studied.
context_quotes: The conduction mechanism for Ho3+ sample is associated with the small polaron whereas the hopping conduction mechanism is predominant mechanism for the samples doped with the rest of rare-earth ions.

records.subject: Ho3+, Sm3+, Nd3+, Gd3+, Ce3+-doped samples
records.conditions: Investigated W-type hexaferrite; thermoelectric-power measurements over 300–750 K
records.quote: The influence of R2O3 substitution on the electrical properties and the thermoelectric power on the W-type hexaferrite Ba0.95R0.05 Mg-0.5 Zn-0.5 CO Fe-16 O-27; R=Y3+, Er3+, Ho3+, Sm3+, Nd3+, Gd3+, and Ce3+ ions as a function of the absolute temperature and frequency in the ranges 300-750 K and 100 kHz-4 MHz, respectively have been studied.
context_quotes: The thermoelectric power measurements indicated that the samples are n-type semiconductors except Er3+ and Y3+ samples, where the thermoelectric power of them is positive at low temperature but nearly above 480 and 375 K, respectively transits to negative.
modality_evidence: The thermoelectric power measurements indicated that the samples are n-type semiconductors except Er3+ and Y3+ samples, where the thermoelectric power of them is positive at low temperature but nearly above 480 and 375 K, respectively transits to negative.
